operation: Reflection s_d(r)=r-(r dot d)/4*d in doubled root coordinates, d an existing D5 root. Family coordinates unchanged. This uses the given full D5 action, not only C/X Lie words.
scope: Positive current-carrier completion if the full original W(D5) action is supplied on that source, with transported phases/markings. Not a field insertion, physical SM gauge identification or mu-to-current map.
